# acli-py log

## `acli-py log`

List the changes you made, newest first, with the ids `acli-py undo` takes.

Every command and bulk run that changed Jira is kept in the audit log (dry runs aren't).

```text
acli-py log [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py log
acli-py undo 12
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `20` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |
